XPath. Jira later records that the changes were applied, except for an eld-19 concern being handled separately.

TriggerDefinition is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. A later combined-branch reconciliation for FHIR-53414 updated the same invariant for current R6 semantics while keeping the XPath in valid exists(f:...) form.
